first.rationale: Verify the archived onboarding result because onboarding completion is down 4% while activation is down 6%, and simplifying onboarding directly addresses both leading indicators. Prior signup simplification also improved SMB activation, supporting this direction. Run a standard experiment with downstream qualified-revenue and account-quality guardrails so higher completion does not come at the expense of durable value. Promotional pricing may counter competitor pressure but risks margin and lower-quality revenue; enterprise sales assist is narrower and does not address the current activation decline.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding for self-serve accounts. The verified source shows completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention improved 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Include guardrails for qualified pipeline, meaningful activation, retention, and account quality to ensure higher completion does not dilute downstream value.
